title: Coffee table
guidance: Four legs are notched on their outer faces to take the long aprons, which run the whole length and are themselves mortised for two cross rails. The end aprons are tenoned through the legs and the long aprons and wedged outside; the top is four planks whose outer boards are recessed over the legs' 8 mm locating tabs. Twelve draw-bore pins lock it: one through each leg into an end-apron tenon, one down through each long apron into a cross-rail tenon, and one through each outer top plank into a leg tab. The pins withdraw first, then the top lifts off as one piece and fans open, which is how the frame's joinery is shown.
